title: kb_mcp.py --status does not say when the project's registered kb server runs another clone
goal: kb_mcp.py --status prints a 'registered:' line naming the kb_mcp.py the project's registered kb server runs (local, then project scope) and, when that lies in another clone, that clone's path, its commit and how far behind it is, with the command that re-registers this clone; and kb_mcp.py --register-local replaces a registration that runs another clone's kb_mcp.py instead of reporting 'already registered'. Found in SP-eahtellz on the Windows host: the local registration ran C:/Users/Public/it-ops-kb-perf (3,404 commits behind), and --register-local left it in place until it was removed by hand on 2026-10-07.

run: import subprocess,sys;r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kb_mcp.py','--status'],capture_output=True,text=True);o=r.stdout;ok=any(l.startswith('registered') and 'kb_mcp.py' in l for l in o.splitlines());print('status names the registered kb server script:',ok);sys.exit(r.returncode or int(not ok))
